name: Stat Drawback
description: The user receives a stat decrease in return.

name: Status Drawback
description: The user receives a major status condition.

name: Good Stat Decrease
description: Lowers the target's or other enemies' stats.

name: Good Stat Increase
description: Raises the user's or an ally's stats.

name: Crit
description: Has an increased critical strike chance.

name: 100% Crit
description: Is guaranteed to land a critical strike unless blocked.

name: Recharge
description: Requires a recharge turn after attacking.

name: Drain
description: Absorbs some amount to heal the user.

name: Partial Field Effect
description: Effect on one side of the field.

name: Force Switch Out
description: Forces a Pokémon to switch out.

name: Unique Effect
description: Unique effect, shared by very few or no other moves.

name: Trap
description: Traps a Pokémon, preventing it from fleeing.

name: Shield Break
description: Breaks or ignores a protection effect.

name: Confusion
description: Causes the target to become confused.

name: Increased Priority
description: Has increased priority. (will move before most other moves regardless of Speed)

name: Decreased Priority
description: Has decreased priority. (will move after most other moves regardless of Speed)
